summary: Recommends one sentence per line (semantic line breaks) in RST and Markdown source, which renders as normal paragraphs but makes diffs, reviews and editing easier.
questions: What is one sentence per line and why does Ansible use it?
How do I start a new paragraph when using one sentence per line?
Does one sentence per line change how the docs render?

answer_card.title: One sentence per line
answer_card.answer_md: Write each sentence on its own line (see sembr.org). Adjacent lines still render as one paragraph; add a blank line for a new paragraph. It makes diffs clean (no reflowed lines), and makes it easier to reorder, comment on or spot overly long sentences. See `docs/docsite/rst/getting_started/` for examples.
